distribution.summary: 福建；广东；湖南；云南；台湾；香港
distribution.narrative: Current occurrence is supported by Johnson et al. (2020) from Fujian, Guangdong, Hunan, Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) provides earlier Taiwan evidence under the source name Hypocryphalus mangiferae and treats it as a first Taiwan record, with material from Hualien (Liyutan), Pingtung (Kenting), Taichung (National Chunghsing University) and Taitung (Taimali). Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Mangifera indica, Mangifera odorata and molecularly verified Choerospondias axillaris are retained as current hosts from Johnson et al. (2020). Beaver & Liu (2010) independently reports Mangifera indica, which is concordant and adds no new host taxon.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus mangiferae Stebbing, 1914.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus mangiferae Stebbing, 1914, VSN_1746. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses the historical combination Hypocryphalus mangiferae (Stebbing). Johnson et al. (2020) uses Cryphalus mangiferae and newly synonymizes Taenioglyptes artestriatus Browne, 1970 with it. Both historical nomenclatural contexts are preserved without changing the stable VSN.
